message.reasoning_content:
We need to determine the crime(s) based on facts. The facts: Yang (male) introduced a 12-year-old girl (minor) to a hair salon run by Deng (already convicted of forced prostitution) and handed her over to Deng. The girl was forced into prostitution. So the crime is "组织、强迫、引诱、容留、介绍卖淫" (i.e., forced prostitution, trafficking of minors for prostitution). The examples: earlier similar case: "组织、强迫、引诱、容留、介绍卖淫;协助组织卖淫" gave answer "组织、强迫、引诱、容留、介绍卖淫;协助组织卖淫". In that example, they had both parties. Here, Yang introduced minor to prostitution. So crime: "组织、强迫、引诱、容留、介绍卖淫". Possibly also "拐卖儿童" but not exactly; it's forced prostitution of a minor. The typical Chinese criminal law article: "组织、强迫、引诱、容留、介绍他人卖淫罪". So answer: [罪名]组织、强迫、引诱、容留、介绍卖淫<eoa>.

Check if any other crimes: maybe "拐卖妇女儿童" but not indicated kidnapping, just introduction. So single crime.
